title: Escalator Brushes Are Not For Your Shoes

scenes.narration: Those brushes on the side of an escalator are not there to clean your shoes. They're warning you.
scenes.note: Open mid-misuse. Dex is already scrubbing his shoe on the brush, delighted.

scenes.narration: The dangerous part is the tiny gap between the moving steps and the stationary side panel.
scenes.note: The mechanism. Camera goes in tight on the seam so the gap is unmissable.

scenes.narration: Loose shoelaces, clothes, or bags can get caught there,
scenes.note: Three things get eaten in sequence. Fast, rhythmic, escalating — then Mochi.

scenes.narration: so the brushes touch your shoes and naturally encourage you to move your feet away from the edge.

scenes.narration: Basically, every time you rub your shoe against one because it feels nice, the escalator is politely asking you to stop standing next to the part that can eat it.
